stem.text: Four forces, all in the same plane, act on an object.

stem.alt: Diagram of a rectangular object with four arrows: an arrow labelled 12 N pointing up, an arrow labelled 12 N pointing down, an arrow labelled 20 N pointing left and an arrow labelled 20 N pointing right.

stem.text: What could describe the motion of the object?

B.text: It is moving in a straight line.

C.text: It is moving with decreasing speed.

D.text: It is moving with increasing momentum.
